div.div: Ongoing alignment: The Xt-EHR logical models are continuously reviewed and refined. Updates from Xt-EHR will be progressively incorporated into this implementation guide to maintain alignment with evolving EHDS specifications.

div.p: This page explains how the conceptual elements of the document body logical model are represented by the corresponding FHIR profiles used in this implementation guide.

ul.li: Mapping scope: A.2-A.3 FT-request document body
